question:
A school offers advanced classes to more students from affluent backgrounds than from poor backgrounds.

What inference is valid?
solution:
Given:

 
• A school offers advanced classes.
 
• More students from affluent backgrounds are enrolled than from poor backgrounds.
 
• We must draw only what is logically and directly inferable from the statement.
